name: Cheesy Ground Beef "Taco" Stuffed Peppers with Lettuce & Tomato Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6-inches from the top.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 red bell peppers
1 ½ limes
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ heads romaine lettuce
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers lengthwise. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, then arrange cut-side down.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, flipping once, until peppers are lightly charred and tender, 6-7 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add beef and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground beef
1 tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp onion powder
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¼ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the beef is cooking, juice limes into a large bowl. Add oil and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the dressing (reserving the other half for the beef).
When the beef is done, add reserved cilantro and half of the cheese (setting the rest aside for topping the peppers) to the skillet; stir to combine the filling.
Divide beef mixture between pepper halves and top with remaining cheese. Return baking sheet to the oven and broil until cheese is melted and bubbly, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, halve lettuce lengthwise, then chop crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips; add to the bowl with the dressing and cilantro.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide stuffed peppers and salad between plates. Enjoy!
